Mark the 90° anticlockwise rotation around (1, -1); Subtract centre (1, -1), turn each relative (x, y) into (−y, x), then add the centre. Map A (0, 1) to A′(-1, -2); retain A and A′. Map B (4, 1) to B′(-1, 2) and C (0, 3) to C′(-3, -2); join A′B′C′. Check the coordinate rule on all three vertices; image A′(-1, -2), B′(-1, 2), C′(-3, -2).
